summary.text: Brent Cox, a Republican, has represented Georgia House District 28, which includes parts of Forsyth and Hall counties, since January 9, 2023.

paragraphs.text: He attended Milton High School and graduated from the University of Georgia in 1994.

According to his legislative biography, he has owned businesses for over 31 years, coached football in Forsyth and Dawson counties for twelve years, and worked as a math teacher at Lambert High School. He lives in Dawsonville.
